subject: planner: consider limit-offset clause in IndexLookUp's cost formula (#62560)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver2.go` and `pkg/planner/core/plan_cost_ver2_test.go`. The change caps IndexLookUpReader’s `indexRows`/`tableRows` by `PushedLimit.Count`, which matches runtime behavior where `PushedLimit` avoids table-side lookups for OFFSET rows and only fetches up to COUNT rows; no correctness/semantics/data-consistency/privilege/session/concurrency Blocker/High risks found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and the same costing logic remains in place (no later fix needed for Blocker/High concerns identified here).
